We need to listen to industry leaders and experts who are sounding the alarm about the dangers and risks of Artificial Intelligence and develop a balanced and thoughtful approach. While we need to stay ahead of the curve and not fall behind China, we must also have safeguards in place to protect privacy, communities, the environment, our national security and humanity. In my opinion, this would include national standards, federal licensing, consumer protections and mandatory incident reporting and response protocols to be in a position to intercept bad actors using AI for malice.
